name: Occlusion-Aware Visibility Filter
definition: A visibility filter for densification statistics that restricts influence to Gaussians that actually participate in rendering the image, replacing the view-frustum test which reflects potential, not actual, observations.
summary: The Occlusion-Aware Visibility Filter replaces standard view-frustum tests in 3D Gaussian Splatting with a rendering-based signal using summed blending weights to restrict densification to actually visible Gaussians.
